description: React Native component for editing user name in account settings, including UI rendering, form validation, and GraphQL mutation handling.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Handles successful user update, shows success message, and navigates back.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during GraphQL mutation, displays error messages.

methods.name: validateName
methods.description: Validates the name input, performs mutation if valid.

methods.name: updateName
methods.description: Calls validateName and performs the update mutation if validation passes.

methods.name: handleNamePressUpdate
methods.description: Triggers the name update process when user presses the update button.
